correctness.rationale: The maximal geodesics are exactly the diameter-two paths of the two explicit types. Hub-free omissions are exactly rim cliques. Hub-containing transversals are cyclic words whose unselected runs have lengths 0,1,2; inclusion minimality is equivalent to six allowed consecutive gap pairs and hub essentiality. The transfer matrix counts those cyclic words with correct n/k rooting and proves the complete cardinality spectrum. Exact finite graph-shortest-path enumeration verifies minimal coefficients through n=12 and all-set coefficients through n=10; the theorem for arbitrary n follows from the proof, not the program.

value.rationale: The result distinguishes all inclusion-minimal geodesic-hitting choices, not merely the previously computed optimum. It shows an interval of attainable hub-dependent sizes together with an isolated hub-free extremum, with exactly ceil(n/2)-4 absent intermediate sizes for every n>=9. Such growing gaps and exact coefficient counts quantify nonoptimal but irredundant coverage in a natural graph family and are not just a routine scalar reparameterization.
